messages:
Anna CS: Quick sync — BrightNova renewal coming up (Apr 10). They asked for a one-pager showing service health last quarter, plus the formula we use for any usage credits. Can we align on numbers and a simple chart tomorrow? cc @Mike CSM @Jordan SA

Mike CSM: Yep — I can join. Do we have the canonical report query and the credit calc template?

Jordan SA: For numbers: we ran 99.92% uptime last quarter across hosted, dedicated pooled. p95 overall ~310ms, p50 ~85ms. Biggest latency blips on /generate during peak days (routing policy fallback).

Jordan SA: Quick prometheus-ish snippet I used to sanity-check p95:```quantile_over_time(0.95, request_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/generate"}[30d])```

Jordan SA: And simple uptime calc we show:```uptime = 1 - (total_downtime_seconds / total_period_seconds)```

Lina PM: For the one-pager, can we have: 1) uptime % and windows of downtime, 2) p50/p95/p99, 3) incident brief for any >5min outage, 4) credit calc example with numbers? I can draft slides if you drop the figures. :memo:

Sam Eng: I'll investigate the /generate routing fallback — suspect autoscaler + warm-up caused queuing. Will run a small reprod test in staging and share logs.

Anna CS: Also need to confirm how credits are applied for mixed deployments. BrightNova uses hosted for prod, dedicated for internal batch. Do we prorate credits across workloads or issue a single account-level credit?

Mike CSM: Per contract we apply account-level credits and then itemize by deployment for transparency. Example in the template: total_credit = SLA_weighted_fraction * monthly_commit_value. I will paste the template after this thread.

ops_bot: Deploy notice: service/redwood-api v4.12.1 rolled to prod at 2025-12-08T09:22:17Z by ci-bot :rocket:

Sam Eng: Thanks — that deploy aligns with the first latency spike window. I'll correlate traces (jaeger link) and drop findings here.

Jordan SA: For the report, I'd add the following small calculation snippet to show customers how we compute credit (text they can read): "Credit = max(0, (SLO_target - Observed_SLO) / SLO_target) * Billing_period_amount" — include worked example with numbers.

Lina PM: Sweet. Can we aim to have a draft by EOD tomorrow? I'll make the slide template and ask legal to sign off on the wording for credits.

Anna CS: EOD tomorrow works. Action items: @Sam Eng run trace correlation and confirm root cause; @Jordan SA prepare metric extracts (p50/p95/p99 + downtime windows); @Mike CSM paste credit template and customer-facing wording; @Lina PM assemble slide. We'll review 9:30am tomorrow. :eyes: :thumbsup:

Mike CSM: On it — will upload the template to the shared folder: https://redwood.app/drive/brightnova-renewal (placeholder)

Sam Eng: Starting the test now, will ping when I have logs.

Jordan SA: Exporting metric CSVs now and will attach to the doc.

Anna CS: Thanks team. If BrightNova asks for a mid-week interim, we can share the draft numbers and note final legal credit calc pending.

ops_bot: Reminder: renewal_alert for account BrightNova scheduled 2026-04-03T08:00:00Z.

Mike CSM: +1 — I'll also prep the renewal playbook items (enablement call, exec summary).
